name: images-slider

frames.best_why: A clean full-bleed lake photo with the headline and button, no transition gap.

tagline: Full-bleed photos tip away every five seconds behind a fixed headline.
summary: A full-screen photo carousel where each landscape image tips and slides out while the next scales up from a tilted card. A dark overlay holds a white headline and a small pill button still.
appearance: A full-bleed landscape photograph fills the panel under a dark overlay, with a white two-line headline and a small outlined pill button centred on top. In transition the next image appears as a tilted rectangle at an edge.
behaviour: Every five seconds the current photo tips and slides out while the next scales in from a rotated card. The left and right arrow keys move back and forward, and the headline overlay stays fixed.
demo_content: Mountain, beach, tent and lake photos; headline Places worth the long flight.
search_phrases: full screen photo slideshow with text
images that flip in from the edge
photo banner that changes every few seconds
use_when: A travel, venue or product hero where big photography should rotate behind one fixed message.
avoid_when: Many large photos: every image is loaded up front, so bandwidth cost is high.
customise: Pass an images array, overlay content as children, a direction and autoplay; the overlay darkness and slide motion are fixed.
weight_why: Preloads every photo at full size and animates large scaled images.

a11y.note: Arrow keys work, but there are no visible controls, images have no alt text, and autoplay cannot be paused.

issues: No visible next or previous controls, so only arrow keys navigate.
Autoplay runs on a fixed five-second timer and cannot be paused.
Photos have no alt text for screen readers.
polish_why: Rich photography and a smooth tilt transition; no visible controls or pause.
title: Images Slider
